why: B formalizes (5) as printed: right arrow t, so the square says t ∘ F = F ∘ s on 𝐔(ψ₀). As its author predicted, B does not hold as we read it. not_B applies B to the identity functor of ℤ/2 ⋉ ℝ at x = 0 (EpFunctor.isProperCovering_id), with a natural representation inside B's V (Chapter 7's theorem_7_1). Any open 𝐔(ψ₀) ∋ ψ₀ = (−1, 0) contains some (−1, y), y ≠ 0, where t(F(−1, y)) = −y ≠ y = F(s(−1, y)). This re-does the argument of the project's theorem_8_5_five_as_printed, rt_check OK. So A ⇒ B is false (not_A_to_B), and B ⇒ A holds only ex falso. The project reads (5) with s on both sides (comm_src, plus the companion comm_tgt) and records the printed version as false in A (five_as_printed, nonvacuous). The exact difference is the right arrow. BRepaired is B with the right arrow s (s : 𝐔(F ψ₀) → U(x) an sc-diffeomorphism, s ∘ F = F ∘ s), and A ⇔ BRepaired is proved both ways. A_to_BRepaired uses theorem_8_5_of_naturalRep, the 'every sufficiently small U(x)' reading that B also uses, on the NaturalRep built from B's action: U connected, and Φ(g⁻¹) is the inverse because Φ(1) = id. BRepaired_to_A builds the chart from BRepaired's clauses, proving three fields itself: connectedComponentIn_eq (Chapter 7); the disjointness of the 𝐔(ψ₀) over all morphisms over F⁻¹(x), which B states only per mor(y, y'); and the t-square (functoriality, with t-diffeo from (1) at g = F(ψ₀)). theorem_8_5 then follows with theorem_7_1, and nonvacuous from it. exists_data, isScSmoothOn_of_section and five_as_printed were re-proved outright. Universes at 0.
B_issue: B formalizes (5) literally with the right arrow t (t ∘ F = F ∘ s on 𝐔(ψ₀)), which the author flags as false, with the same ℤ/2 ⋉ ℝ counterexample the project uses. That makes B false (not_B), which matches the project's reading. BRepaired in the Items file (right arrow s, the author's first suggested reading) is equivalent to A.
intended: BRepaired ((5) with the right arrow s): A_to_BRepaired and BRepaired_to_A both proved and #rt_check OK, both using their hypothesis.
overlap: B_to_A (ex falso via not_B): 574 shared project theorems; BRepaired_to_A: 588. These are Chapter 7's theorem_7_1 machinery (NatRepConstruction.Sheets.*, exists_naturalRep_sheets, lemma_7_8, lemma_7_9, NaturalRep field lemmas, connectedComponentIn_morOn, iUnion_image_Γ, pairwise_disjoint_image_Γ) and the reflection groupoid (actionEpGroupoid proof fields, isScSmoothMap_units_smul, units_smul_rn_neg_one, reflectionψ₀_mem_morOn). They also include EpFunctor.isProperCovering_id, the IsProperCovering field projections, ProperCoveringChart field projections and M-polyfold infrastructure.
